CLAUDE.md is revised and now has **118 lines** (the old file had 116, and git diff shows +98/−96). It is the only tracked file changed: `git status -uno` lists just `M CLAUDE.md`. Nothing was staged or committed, I did not run Godot, and I did not touch shaders/. The prompt asked for exactly 7 sections, but CLAUDE.md now has 8 headings. I dropped the old A6 "Headless facts" section.

File: D:\CSYE 7370\csye-7270-course\fall-2026\jingyao-y\assignment-7\walker-downfall\CLAUDE.md

AGENTS.md does not exist, so there is no `@AGENTS.md` first line. The sections, in order, are:
- Project context
- Current change (exactly `@CHANGE-BRIEF.md`)
- Ownership (the shaders/ rule kept, plus the new clips rule)
- One authority
- Godot 4 names
- Out of scope
- Unconfirmed

**Files read**
- CLAUDE.md, CHANGE-BRIEF.md, README.md, project.godot, .gitignore
- scripts/run-test.sh, scripts/run-baseline.sh
- game/main.tscn
- entities/player.gd (excerpts: 247–276, 478–512, 695–709, 770–779, 836–905, 1855–1869, 1955–1969, plus grep), entities/operator_kit.gd (240–254), entities/kits/lappland_kit.gd
- godot_assets/lappland_animator_3d.gd (1–90 plus function grep)
- art/field_art.gd (150–189)
- world/continuous_world_map.gd (2494–2505, 2670–2734), world/base_map.gd (760–777)
- game/gm_camera.gd (grep with context, 68–147), game/game_manager.gd (372–385, 650–663, 5850–5863), game/pixel_display.gd (grep), game/gm_route.gd and game/gm_camp.gd (grep only)
- tests/test_lappland.gd, tests/test_lappland_input.gd
- tests/test_base_crew.gd:57 and tests/test_base_scene.gd:109 (grep hits only)

I did not open the other ~100 test suites; I grepped them for NPC, wave and sprite references. Also listed: scripts/, tests/, prompts/, a .tscn glob, and the git log.

**Could not confirm (also written in CLAUDE.md's Unconfirmed section)**
- **Two writers to `visible`.** The brief has `LapplandAnimator3D.show_rig()` set its own `visible` (CHANGE-BRIEF.md:106-109). But `Player` already writes `_sprite.visible` for Amiya's shadow skill (entities/player.gd:1867, 1963). That would make two writers to one node, which the new rule forbids. The user needs to decide before the rig step.
- **Existing tests will break.** The brief says existing test expectations stay unchanged (CHANGE-BRIEF.md:226-227). Change 1 breaks these:
  - tests/test_lappland.gd:100 and :147 expect the wave to spawn and the charge to clear on the click call itself.
  - tests/test_lappland.gd:100 and tests/test_lappland_input.gd:78 expect `action_name == "wave"`.
- **Godot 4 property names are unverified.** None of the AnimationPlayer/Animation/Sprite3D names in that section are confirmed for 4.7.2 by any file or probe here. The exception is the SubViewport update-mode constants, which game/pixel_display.gd:26,67 uses. CLAUDE.md says to probe before relying on the others.
- **Renderer is not proven at runtime.** It is stated in README.md:4-5 and the brief, but project.godot sets no `rendering_method`. No run log in this repo shows what Godot actually reported (A6's captures/ was not carried over).
- **Wrapper location disagrees.** README.md:51 says the wrapper finds Godot "three folders up"; scripts/run-test.sh:11 uses five.
- **Pending provenance.** The rig parts' original sheet path, the image model's name and version, and its terms are marked "pending" in the brief (CHANGE-BRIEF.md:116-127).
- **No realtime test named.** The brief does not assign any suite to realtime mode. It gives 60 fps only for the state and edge tests (:254-255), so the 60 fps I wrote for the read-back and pins suites is the repo default, not the brief's.
- **Small line drift.** The brief cites `action_time += delta` at :217; it is at :229 inside `_process()`, which starts at :217.
- **Other files' references are partly unchecked.** Ripgrep skips the force-added game files because .gitignore ignores `/*`, so a repo-wide grep only reached tests/ and files I named directly. Other writers to the player sprite or NPC figures beyond the files listed above were not ruled out.
